summary_hint: whose ID this is (name components), which jurisdiction and credential type, and whether it is currently valid (expiration vs today) — plus DOB and residential address for cross-document identity and occupancy matching.

typed_core.name: credential_type
typed_core.why: identity + disambiguator — DL vs state ID vs CDL vs passport; ID-5's 'government-issued ID' scope depends on it.

typed_core.name: issuing_jurisdiction
typed_core.why: identity — which state issued; context for ID-1 name rules and OC-1 address; processor.

typed_core.name: issuer_name
typed_core.why: issuer/source — the DMV/authority; processor authenticity check.

typed_core.name: license_or_id_number_masked
typed_core.why: PII (pre-masked, last-4) — identity/dedup key; already in _PII_FIELDS as id_number_masked.
typed_core.prompt_hint: Mask the license/ID number to last-4 everywhere; never emit the full number, DOB, or address in reasoning.

typed_core.name: full_name_raw
typed_core.why: ID-1 disambiguator — the name exactly as printed, so a wrong surname/given split stays visible to the tag layer. Flattened from person[].
typed_core.prompt_hint: Capture the name as components (family/given/middle/suffix) in addition to the raw printed line — ID-1 canonicalizes each part.

typed_core.name: family_name
typed_core.why: ID-1 — surname for tolerant/containment match (suffix strip, maiden vs married).

typed_core.name: given_names
typed_core.why: ID-1 — given name(s) for nickname-map / containment match.

typed_core.name: date_of_birth
typed_core.why: ID-3 (DOB match across ID and application); PII (highly_restricted).
typed_core.prompt_hint: Dates may be MM/DD/YYYY or ISO; keep the value parseable as a real date so ID-3/ID-5 can compare.

typed_core.name: expiration_date
typed_core.why: ID-5 — compare expiration_date >= today (and at closing).

typed_core.name: issue_date
typed_core.why: processor (document age) + disambiguator — issue vs expiration are both dates on the card; carrying issue date prevents reading one for the other.
typed_core.prompt_hint: Distinguish DL field codes: 4a = issue, 4b = expiration, 4d = license number, 3 = DOB.

typed_core.name: residential_address
typed_core.why: OC-1 — the address signal compared against stated occupancy. Flattened from address.

typed_core.name: photo_present
typed_core.why: processor/authenticity — a photo ID without a photo is a red flag; CORE.

rejected.name: document_title, form_number, form_revision_date
rejected.reason: a license is not a filed form; classification handles the type

rejected.name: document_issue_date, effective_date, statement_period_start/_end
rejected.reason: issue_date/expiration_date are the credential dates; the rest duplicate or don't apply

rejected.name: party_names (person[])
rejected.reason: single holder — flattened to full_name_raw + components

rejected.name: signature_blocks / notary_block
rejected.reason: an ID is not executed/notarized; photo_present covers authenticity

rejected.name: document_discriminator
rejected.reason: restricted, no rule/consumer — do not surface a restricted number needlessly

rejected.name: sex, height, eye_color
rejected.reason: physical descriptors — no rule, no processor use

rejected.name: signature_present
rejected.reason: photo_present is the authenticity signal a rule/processor uses; signature adds nothing

rejected.name: vehicle_class, restrictions, endorsements
rejected.reason: driving attributes irrelevant to a mortgage file

rejected.name: barcode_aamva_fields (key_value[])
rejected.reason: machine-zone dump — cross-check only; catch-all, not a nested list

rejected.name: name_truncation_indicators
rejected.reason: full_name_raw already preserves the printed form for audit

encoding_variations: Expiration may read 'EXP 05/01/2028', '4b 2028-05-01', or an AAMVA-coded date in the PDF417 barcode; must be the expiration, not the issue date '4a' — hence issue_date is carried alongside as its disambiguator.
Name may print as one line ('SMITH, ROBERT J JR'), as separate DL fields (1=family, 2=given), and truncated with a truncation flag — capture components and full_name_raw so a bad split is auditable.
Jurisdiction appears as the state name, a state seal, or a two-letter code; normalize but keep as printed.
Credential type distinguishes a REAL-ID DL, a standard DL, a CDL, and a non-driver state ID — all valid identity docs but different credential_type.

open_questions.q: DOB masking vs comparison. ID-3 compares actual dates, so DOB must be registered pre_masked=false and compared via the snapshot match-hash — confirm the snapshot exposes a date-comparable hash (not just an opaque string) so date-format tolerance still works.
options: register raw + rely on the normalized snapshot date for the compare, hash for storage/display
open_questions.recommendation: register raw + rely on the normalized snapshot date for the compare, hash for storage/display.

open_questions.q: Name components vs raw only. ID-1 could split full_name_raw at runtime instead of storing components.
options: store raw only and split at runtime
open_questions.recommendation: store both — components make the canonicalization deterministic and the raw line keeps a bad split auditable; cost is four cheap str fields.

open_questions.q: credential_type / issuing_jurisdiction as enums. No enum coercer exists; both degrade to str.
open_questions.recommendation: confirm downstream normalization (state code, credential taxonomy) rather than adding a coercer.

notes: Every rule on this document is an identity/validity comparison, so the floor is small but exacting: the name must be captured as components (ID-1), DOB and expiration must be real dates (ID-3, ID-5), and the address must survive for OC-1.

PII: license_or_id_number_masked already registered as id_number_masked (rename/alias on build). date_of_birth is a typed field but absent from _PII_FIELDS today, so it is stored unmasked — the fix that matters most is registering it pre_masked=false. residential_address is standard sensitivity, promoted to typed to keep it out of the unmasked catch-all but not proposed for masking (flag for Priya) — pii object left null accordingly.
Ambiguity: credential_type is tagged identity + disambiguator; classified disambiguator (ID-5 scope) with ID-5 in rules.
Ambiguity: issue_date is tagged processor (document age) + disambiguator; classified disambiguator (prevents misreading expiration).
